findings.evidence: Lines 394-402 use only `causallyFollows_zero_iff` (Physlib `Relativity/Causality/CausallyFollows.lean:63`), `minkowskiProduct_self_le_timeComponent_sq`, and `0 < M²` via `nlinarith [T.mass_pos]`; nothing about the mass shell or `Λ` beyond `causallyFollows_zero_smul`. No upstream equivalent exists: grepping `timeComponent_pos` across ./upstream yields only `Velocity.timeComponent_pos` (Physlib `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Velocity/Basic.lean:48`).
findings.fix: Extract `lemma timeComponent_pos_of_causallyFollows_zero (h : causallyFollows 0 y) (hy : 0 < ⟪y, y⟫ₘ) : 0 < y.timeComponent` into the vector-level extension module (e.g. `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`, where the other general Minkowski facts of this PR live) and apply it to `Λ • K.p`, `Λ • K.pPrime`.
findings.issue: The `hpos` block inside `exists_isBreitFrame` proves a general vector fact — a causal vector of positive Minkowski square has positive time component — but states it only for `⟪x, x⟫ₘ = T.mass ^ 2` under a fixed `Λ`, locking it inside a hadron-kinematics theorem.

findings.evidence: Physlib `Relativity/LorentzGroup/Boosts/Generalized.lean:258-260`: `@[simp] lemma generalizedBoost_apply_fst (u v : Velocity d) : generalizedBoost u v • u.1 = v.1`. The new lemma's whole proof is `rw [generalizedBoost_apply_fst, Velocity.zero_spatialPart]`, and its only use is `GeneralizedExtensions.lean:51`.
findings.fix: Delete it and inline `rw [generalizedBoost_apply_fst, Velocity.zero_spatialPart]` at its one call site (line 51), or, if a spatial-part form is wanted, state it generally as `(generalizedBoost u v • u.1).spatialPart = v.1.spatialPart`.
findings.issue: `spatialPart_generalizedBoost_smul_eq_zero` is the `v := 0` case of the upstream `@[simp] generalizedBoost_apply_fst`, composed with `Velocity.zero_spatialPart`; it is a trivial restatement of an existing Physlib result in an upstream namespace, with a single use.

summary: The shared equal-square lemmas are at the right level and remove the former GPD proof duplication, but two pieces sit below it: a general causality fact is proved inline only for mass-shell momenta, and a new upstream-namespace lemma is a two-rewrite specialization of an existing Physlib simp lemma.
